description: Figure 8 illustrates the results of layer-wise quantized pruning on the Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct model, using SnapKV as the pruning method with a KV cache budget of 1/64. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from Layer 1-4 to Layer 29-32, with tick labels at each layer. The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from -12% to 3%, with tick labels at 0%, -3%, -6%, -9%, and -12%. There are three lines plotted: a light blue solid line with circle markers representing “Lib-Avg of 2-tokens, 8-bit”, a red dashed line with square markers representing “Baseline of 2-tokens, 8-bit”, and a green solid line with diamond markers representing “Lib-Avg of 1-tokens, 16-bit”. The light blue line starts at approximately 0.2% at Layer 1-4, decreases to approximately -1.5% at Layer 5-12, increases to approximately 1.5% at Layer 13-20, and then decreases to approximately -0.5% at Layer 29-32. The red dashed line begins at approximately 0% at Layer 1-4, decreases to approximately -3% at Layer 5-12, increases to approximately 1.5% at Layer 13-20, and then decreases to approximately 0% at Layer 29-32. The green line starts at approximately 0.1% at Layer 1-4, decreases to approximately -1.5% at Layer 5-12, increases to approximately 1.5% at Layer 13-20, and then decreases to approximately -0.5% at Layer 29-32.
